results.intentUsed: This page estimates shipping and discounts for a $42.00 cart. Work through these checks in order and record exactly what you observe for each: 1. Read the Subtotal, Shipping and Order total, then confirm the arithmetic: order total must equal subtotal minus any discount plus shipping. 2. Apply the promo code SAVE10 and check the Discount line equals exactly 10% of the SUBTOTAL (not of subtotal plus shipping) — state both numbers. 3. With SAVE10 still applied, apply an obviously invalid code such as NOTREAL; confirm the invalid-code error appears AND that the previous discount is removed rather than silently kept. 4. results.intentUsed: This is a 3-step onboarding wizard. Work through these checks in order and record exactly what you observe for each: 1. On step 1 press Continue with everything empty and confirm each required field shows an error. 2. Enter an email with NO dot in the domain, for example sam@example (plus a valid workspace name and display name), press Continue, and record whether the wizard accepts it — a malformed email must be rejected. 3. On step 2 pick a focus area, then set 'Max notes per day' to 25 and press Continue; the field states the allowed range is 1 to 20, so 25 must be rejected — record what happens. 4. On step 3 add three notes with DISTINCT text (for example 'alpha', 'beta', 'gamma'), then remove the SECOND one and record exactly which note text disappeared and which remain. 5. Finish and confirm the summary's note count matches the number of notes you actually left in the list.
